problem: Which of the following is the graph of $y=\frac{1}{2(x+1)}?$
worked_solution:
To plot $y=\frac{1}{2(x+1)},$ we apply the following steps:

- Take the curve $y=\frac{1}{x}.$

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/13831126/assets/a32495fcca947d01cf8d3218fc5cfc0cce083a34e6fb6b629d92ba9e47039a6e.png)

- Translate it by $1$ unit to the left to get the graph of $y=\frac{1}{x+1}.$

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/13831126/assets/049f9c306c007026bc72e5f00d925cf22d80d94049aa82e3c81d7fc7c289249f.png)

- Then, stretch the result by a scale factor of $\frac{1}{2}$ parallel to the $y$-axis to get the graph of $y=\frac{1}{2(x+1)}.$

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/13831126/assets/c52f568868328061237d43e4650180321ec4a40e886a62f4a678f0276afe821b.png)
